notes: Papers are linked from the MAA-authorised LIVE by Po-Shen Loh archive. Worked solutions include hints and explanatory reasoning; they are not labelled official MAA solutions.
The archive contains every named AMC 12 paper from 2000 to 2025: 52 papers. A and B variants began in 2002.
Both spring and fall competitions took place in 2021. LIVE uses C and D in its URLs for Fall A and Fall B; this archive labels the actual season and variant.
AIME qualification scores are historical thresholds for that paper, not forecasts for a future competition. AMC papers do not use UKMT gold, silver and bronze boundaries.
The 2026 AMC papers have not taken place as of 10 September 2026; the published MAA dates are 5 and 13 November 2026.
Before practising an older paper, check its original scoring instructions because blank-answer scoring changed over time.
The separately labelled 1950–1999 archive contains predecessor examinations, including AHSME. These were not called AMC 12 at the time and used different paper lengths and scoring.
